name: Save.design
summary: Website design inspiration gallery with tech-stack detection, plus a workspace to save and organize finds.
description: A curated gallery of website designs that shows the framework and animation library behind each site, with filters for framework, animation library, category and industry, and pages gathering sites by font or UI element. A membership workspace adds AI-catalogued captures ('Smart Capture'), folders, canvases, a Chrome extension and a personal MCP endpoint so teams can build their own reusable inspiration library.
contains: 1093 website examples in the public gallery
filters by framework, animation library, category and industry
tech-stack detection for each saved site
font pages listing sites that use a typeface (Doto, Druk, Elza …)
Smart Capture fills title, description, tags and category with AI
Chrome extension for single and bulk tab saving
